headword: {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}

definitions.explanation: The rightmost lane (in Japan) of a multi-lane road or expressway, designated for overtaking slower vehicles. Drivers are expected to return to the travel lane after passing.

examples.japanese: {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}に{移|うつ}って{追|お}い{越|こ}す。
examples.english: Move to the passing lane and overtake.

examples.japanese: {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}をずっと{走|はし}り{続|つづ}けるのは{違反|いはん}だ。
examples.english: Continuously driving in the passing lane is a violation.

examples.japanese: {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}に{遅|おそ}い{車|くるま}がいると{渋滞|じゅうたい}の{原因|げんいん}になるので、{追|お}い{越|こ}し{後|ご}はすぐに{走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}に{戻|もど}りましょう。
examples.english: A slow car in the passing lane causes traffic jams, so return to the driving lane immediately after overtaking.

notes:
A compound of {追越|おいこし} (overtaking, passing) + {車線|しゃせん} (lane). In Japan's left-hand traffic system, the passing lane is on the right side. Staying in the {追越車線|おいこししゃせん} without passing ({通行帯違反|つうこうたいいはん}) is subject to a fine.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}に{入|はい}る: to enter the passing lane
- {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}から{出|で}る: to exit the passing lane
- {追越車線|おいこししゃせん}を{塞|ふさ}ぐ: to block the passing lane

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {走行車線|そうこうしゃせん}: driving lane, travel lane — the standard lane for normal driving
- {登坂車線|とうはんしゃせん}: climbing lane — an extra lane on steep hills for slow vehicles
- {車線変更|しゃせんへんこう}: lane change — the act of moving between lanes
